timers.name: lockAt
timers.effect: round.lock with actor=system. Locks registration only; never starts play or draws.

timers.name: startGrace
timers.effect: After 60 s emit operator warning (admin projection flag `startOverdue`). No automatic start.

invariants: Every mutating command carries commandId (idempotency key) and expectedVersion; a mismatch is rejected with STALE_VERSION (E10) and no mutation.
round.version increments exactly once per accepted mutating command.
Events are emitted only after the durable transaction commits (outbox).
No transition draws a skill except an accepted round.draw.next in PLAYING.
A published winner set is never recalculated; an invalid round is cancelled transparently.

states.READY: 25 selections with server-randomized positions; registration still open; editable (returns to DRAFT)
states.LOCKED_ACTIVE: READY at round lock; included in draw pool and evaluation; immutable
states.DEFERRED: Not READY at lock, or arrived after lock; preserved and reassigned to the next eligible round
